source: module match_legacy; enum Choice<T> {None;Some(value:T);} fn value<T>(c:Choice<T>,fallback:T) -> T {match c {Choice::None() => {return fallback;} Choice::Some(n) => {return n;}}} fn main() -> unit !{io} {print(value(Choice::Some(42),0));} test fn example() -> unit {assert(value(Choice::Some(42),0) == 42);}
